title: Deep-learning-based pipeline for module power prediction from electroluminescense measurements
mechanism: CNN regresses module Pmpp from module EL images, with a CAM variant giving per-cell power loss; inactive regions and cracks are the main loss drivers.
adaptation: 719 public module EL images + Pmpp from the lab family behind ELPV (our weak BMRK source). Cut into cells as a BMRK-like unlabelled pool; use module power loss as a weak bag label for the summed predicted inactive fraction (ranking loss across module pairs); use as a severity validation set for predicted inactive fraction.
min_experiment: Step 1: house model on cell crops of all 719 modules, Spearman(predicted inactive fraction, measured power loss); kill weak-supervision idea if rho < 0.3. Step 2: PF + ranking loss vs PF, CV inactive IoU and BMRK inactive IoU; kill if < +0.02. Download needs user OK.
evidence: R: 719 modules; baseline regression MAE 9.0 W (4.0%), CNN MAE 7.3 W (3.2%); dataset, code and models released.
prior_overlap: Partial: SSL with the 11.9k CSIR/ARTS pool was n.d. at 100% labels, but that pool was not BMRK-like and had no electrical labels. Weak supervision from power is untested.
